scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c red,green "npm run --prefix server dev" "npm run --prefix client dev"
scripts.build: npm run --prefix shared build && npm run --prefix server build && npm run --prefix client build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/dist')) { fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); }"
